text: Righto, sport, and finals fever is well and truly building with both the Broncos and the Cowboys locking in their September campaigns. Two Queensland sides still dancing this late in the year is nothing to sneeze at.

text: I love finals time, the whole state gets a bit louder at the pub on game day. Fingers crossed for an all Queensland decider, though I know that is probably wishful thinking on my part.
